table.description: Monitor-layer copy of Requested Torque (Drive Mode 3, Intelligent, AT/CVT Index 5). The ECU's torque monitor recomputes the torque the driver may have from these copies and checks the engine against it; if the check fails, the ECU closes the throttle and keeps it closed until the engine is restarted (inferred from the code). Nothing else reads it. Keep it identical to Requested Torque (Drive Mode 3, Intelligent, AT/CVT Index 5), or set Torque Monitor Fault Mode to 0. Drive mode is the SI-Drive request received over CAN: 1 Default (also used when no valid request arrives), 2 Sport, 3 Intelligent, 4 Sport Sharp (positions inferred from the FA20 platform). The ECU decodes the request from three bits: the two bits that give Sport and Sport Sharp on their own give mode 7 when both are set. What selects that combination on the car is not identified. Identified from this ECU's code.
